{{Season|Summer}} in the valley |xp = 30 [[Farming#Experience Points|Farming XP]] |sellprice = 300 |edibility = 55 |color = Yellow }} The '''Pineapple''' is a [[Fruits|fruit]] [[crops|crop]] that grows from [[Pineapple Seeds]] after 14 days and continues to produce every 7 days after maturity. ==Stages== {| class="wikitable roundedborder" style="text-align:center;" !Stage 1 !Stage 2 !Stage 3 !Stage 4 !Stage 5 !Harvest !After-Harvest |- |[[File:Pineapple Stage 1.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Pineapple Stage 2.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Pineapple Stage 3.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Pineapple Stage 4.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Pineapple Stage 5.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Pineapple Stage 6.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Pineapple Stage 7.png|center|link=]] |- |1 Day |3 Days |3 Days |4 Days |3 Days |Total: 14 Days |Regrowth: 7 Days |- |} ==Crop Growth Calendar== {{#lst:Crop Growth Calendars|Pineapple}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin, Demetrius, Linus, Shane, Harvey, Pam, Leah, Kent, Jodi, Elliott, Sandy |neutral= Caroline, Pierre, Willy, Clint, Gus, Emily, Sebastian, Marnie, Wizard,Sam, Penny, Lewis, Alex, Maru, George, Evelyn,Leo, Krobus, Dwarf |dislike= Jas, Vincent, Haley, Abigail }} ==Quests== *One Pineapple may be requested by [[Lionfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5. *[[Caroline]] may request 100 Pineapples in the [[Quests#Island Ingredients|"Island Ingredients"]] Special Order. The reward is gold equivalent to 50% of base crop price and the [[Solar Panel]] recipe. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Tropical Curry|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Pineapple can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Pants|Farmer Pants]]. [[File:Farmer Pants.png|36px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6.4|Can now be added to [[Fish Tank]]s as decoration.}} {{NavboxCrop}} [[Category:Fruit]] [[Category:Multiple harvest crops]] [[de:Ananas]] [[es:Piña (fruta)]] [[fr:Ananas]] [[it:Ananas]] [[ja:パイナップル]] [[ko:파인애플]] [[hu:Ananász]] [[pt:Abacaxi]] [[ru:Ананас]] [[tr:Ananas]] [[zh:菠萝]]
